summary: Frontend-only regression test for (a) new customer /contact 'Help & Support' page and (b) admin routing refactor where AdminLayout is now a persistent parent <Outlet/> route and all 25 admin pages had their <AdminLayout> wrapper removed. RESULT: ALL 25 admin pages render correctly with the persistent sidebar, correct active nav highlight, no React crash and no runtime errors. Contact page loads all 5 required testids (contact-phone, contact-email, contact-whatsapp, contact-address, contact-hours) and the Footer 'Help & Support' link navigates to /contact.
verified_flows: GET /contact renders <Contact/> with data-testid contact-page and populated phone (+91 9971818259), email (khurpi.store@gmail.com), WhatsApp card, address (E-312, ACE City, Noida Extension, 201306) and support hours (07:00 - 21:00) sourced from /api/store/settings.
Footer 'Help & Support' button (visible on non-admin pages) navigates from / to /contact.

All 25 admin sidebar buttons present in DOM with data-testid=admin-nav-<id>: dashboard, create-order, orders, users, customer-view, products, categories, subcategories, subscriptions, deliveries, delivery-slots, payments, expenses, cost-calculator, inventory, banners, spin-wheel, coupons, discount-tiers, referrals, pages, analytics, store-settings, app-config, settings.

Clicking each admin-nav-<id>: (1) URL updates to /admin/<id>, (2) content region renders non-empty text (content_len ranged 445 - 4810 chars), (3) sidebar button gets 'bg-white/20' active class, (4) sidebar stays mounted (25 buttons remain in DOM before and after full nav walk), (5) no pageerror / console React error.
grep confirms zero admin pages still import AdminLayout - refactor is clean.
observations: Sidebar persistence verified: <nav> element retained all 25 buttons across every navigation; fingerprint (outerHTML length) varied only by active-class shifts (~small delta).

AdminLayout page header (h1) is only rendered for the routes in titleMap; other pages render their own <h1>. Both visible in screenshots - Settings shows 'Settings', View as Customer page shows its own 'View as Customer' heading.

Pre-existing console noise (unrelated to refactor): Mixed-content warning for http://ip-api.com/json/ from Landing (should switch to https), and multiple 404 asset requests on Landing. Neither affects tested flows.
action_items: OPTIONAL cleanup (pre-existing, not caused by this refactor): switch ip-api.com call to https to remove mixed-content console warnings on Landing.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminLayout mobile sidebar buttons (lg:hidden block) do NOT have data-testid attributes, while the desktop set does. If mobile E2E coverage is desired, add matching testids there too - minor.
AdminLayout has an internal 'switch-project-button' with data-testid but no automated coverage in current tests; consider adding a test case for project switching.
Contact.js correctly falls back to hardcoded defaults when /api/store/settings fails (setSettings({})). Good defensive UX.
App.js admin nested routes are ordered correctly; /admin/login and /admin/projects intentionally kept outside the AdminLayout parent - correct.

The AdminLayout header shows TWO logout buttons on desktop (top bar 'Logout' with data-testid='admin-logout-button' AND sidebar 'Logout' also using data-testid='admin-logout-button'). Duplicate data-testid on two elements can trip Playwright's strict-mode locators; consider unique testids like 'admin-logout-topbar' and 'admin-logout-sidebar'.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Contact page + all 25 admin routes + sidebar persistence)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin routing refactor is fully green. Reusable playbook: (1) login at /admin/login, (2) click [data-testid=project-card-default], (3) after landing on /admin/dashboard wait ~1.5-2s BEFORE first sidebar query (early runs saw first-5 buttons transiently absent right after project select; DOM was 25/25 after 2s wait), (4) iterate data-testid=admin-nav-<id> for all 25 ids listed above. Duplicate data-testid='admin-logout-button' on two elements - use nth() or scope by container if needed.
